cards.subject: The Great Hunt
lines: Eleven hundred years of following the kodo herds, moving camp with the seasons, never stopping.
This city is the end of that sentence.

cards.subject: What they lost
cards.tag: The grassland is called Desolace now
lines: Tauren shamans tried to wake the Earth Mother under their own sacred land, and woke an earth elemental instead. Her regeneration drank the life out of it.
Cenarius's son came to investigate, fell in love with her, and fathered the centaur. The centaur killed him and drove the tauren out.
You can walk into that zone. It is still like that.

cards.subject: A permanent city made of tents
lines: They stopped moving and then built it out of the same materials anyway.
There is almost no stone here and hardly a door in the place.
The architecture of a people who never stopped anywhere is now the architecture of where they stopped.

cards.subject: The lifts
lines: Rope and wood, hand-built, one engineer keeping both of them and the windmills running.
The mesas stand several hundred feet over Mulgore and there is no path, no ramp and no stair.
If the lift is at the top, you wait.

seed.body: Ride the lift facing outward rather than into the rock. It is thirty seconds and it is the best view in the Horde.

cards.subject: Cairne Bloodhoof
lines: He met Thrall when the orcs stopped to help tauren who were being run down by centaur, and said afterwards that he was struck by their nobility and their savagery both.
He guided them across Kalimdor to the Oracle. In return the orcs helped clear the centaur out of Mulgore.
This city exists because of a favour returned.

cards.subject: A refuge, not a fortress
lines: Cairne built it as somewhere tauren of every tribe were welcome, including tribes that had fought each other.
No gate, no chokepoint, nothing to hold. Compare Orgrimmar, built the same decade, which is all wall.
The guards here are called Bluffwatchers. They watch.

cards.subject: Four separate mesas
lines: It is not one plateau. Every trip between two parts of this city is a trip over open air on a wooden bridge.
Nothing is fenced and the edges are simply where the ground stops.
It is the only capital where the main hazard to a level 60 is the floor ending.

cards.subject: The Pools of Vision
cards.tag: Down the hole by the Spirit Rise bridge
lines: Tauren cannot be mages, priests or warlocks. So the people teaching those arts here are Forsaken.
They work in a cave, in the rock, under the most sacred mesa in the city.
Twenty minutes of sky and rope bridges, then a hole full of Lordaeron's dead.

seed.body: There is a tunnel by the Spirit Rise bridge. Go down it. It is not what the rest of this city is.

cards.subject: Hamuul Runetotem
lines: After the Third War he went to Malfurion and asked to be taught. Fandral Staghelm objected to teaching tauren at all.
Malfurion taught him anyway. He was the first tauren druid in nearly twenty generations.
Every tauren druid you have ever grouped with comes from that one request.

cards.subject: Magatha Grimtotem
cards.tag: The same mesa, a few paces away
lines: The Elder Crone leads the Grimtotem and is Cairne's rival for the future of the tauren.
She took her tribe by marrying its leader, who died shortly after in what was recorded as an unforeseen climbing accident.
The archdruid and the woman working against the chieftain live on the same rise, and the Horde tolerates both.
